subject: Surge-tier safeguard credit request — exec approval required
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@novapulse.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: surge-tier safeguard credit for pilot

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from the NovaPulse team — we're seeing unpredictable bursts from our pilot sims that could push us into the next pricing tier several times a week. The CTO (Elaine Young) asked whether Redwood can provide a short-term safeguard credit while we stabilize traffic patterns.

Specifics:
- Pilot runs Sep–Nov, expected steady state ~120k tokens/day but bursts up to 700k/day for 2–6 hours during batch replays.
- We're asking for a temporary surge-tier credit (applied to overage tokens) for a 3-month window, with a soft cap.

Attachments: usage-forecast-q4.xlsx (forecast + burst windows)

Can you advise if this is possible and what margin / approval path is required? We want to avoid losing the momentum from the pilot.

Best,
Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Integrations, NovaPulse Health
samir.shah@novapulse.com
(415) 555-0199
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: surge-tier safeguard credit for pilot — exec approval required

Marissa / Marcus — looping you in for a short-run concession ask from NovaPulse (DEAL-2026-0451). See Samir's forecast attached.

Proposal (from my side): offer a 15% credit on overage tokens for a 3-month period (Sep 15–Dec 15) tied to:
- a maximum monthly surge credit cap of $20k
- commit to weekly traffic telemetry and a short mutual action plan to stabilize bursts

Why: pilot shows clear opportunity to convert to a Dedicated commit in Q1; we want to preserve the sale without creating a permanent price precedent.

Request: can RevOps/Finance confirm margin impact and advise whether this can be approved at VP level or needs CFO signoff? I started a draft concession memo (Drive link) and attached the forecast.

Evelyn — thanks for the heads-up and for drafting the ask. Two quick items I need before we can route to Finance/CFO:

1) Precedent check: any similar concession in the last 12 months for pilot customers? (Comp team keeps an internal log; I'll pull examples but want to avoid creating an unscoped precedent.)
2) Margin impact: using the forecast I ran a quick back-of-envelope — if we concede 15% on overages with a $20k monthly cap across three months, estimated net revenue impact is ~$34k and cash impact in Q4 of ~$20k (assuming 60% of overage is collectible within the quarter).

I'd prefer we limit the concession to: 12% credit, 3-month window, and require a signed addendum that restricts the concession to identified usage patterns (no retroactive claims). Can you confirm NovaPulse accepts an addendum + telemetry sharing? If they accept, I can prepare the concession memo and route for Ben/Finance signature.

Also adding the HubSpot link and legal checklist here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-2026-0451

I've reviewed the numbers and the deal context. Approve conditional concession:
- 12% credit on overage tokens for 3 months (Sep 15–Dec 15)
- Monthly credit cap $18k (reduced to control exposure)
- Require signed addendum + telemetry access + explicit no-retro clause

Marissa — please prepare the concession memo and mark it as "Requires CFO acknowledgement". Finance to validate final P&L hit; if Finance flags >$25k cash impact in Q4 we will need explicit CFO sign-off.

Evelyn — please communicate the revised terms to Samir and get verbal acceptance before we proceed with the legal addendum. Attach the concession-memo-draft.pdf in the HubSpot deal when ready.
